title: Dropping Borrowed Data
goal: Avoid dropping an owner while active references to it still exist.
hints: You cannot move or drop an owner while a reference borrows its field.
Keep the owner alive until all active borrows are no longer used.
explanation: Dropping `cfg` via `std::mem::drop(cfg)` or `std::mem::drop(cfg.port)` fails with E0505/E0507 because `cfg` is currently borrowed by `port_ref`. `let _ = &port_ref` keeps the owner alive while reading through `port_ref`. `port_ref.len() + 0` evaluates to `4`, matching the expected return value.
